name: New Constraint Introduced
description: A previously unknown limitation is added mid-session.

name: Communication Breakdown
description: Information flow between participants becomes restricted or distorted.

name: Resource Shock
description: Sudden increase or reduction in available resources.

name: Role Reversal
description: Participants swap roles or responsibilities mid-task.

name: External Stakeholder Intervention
description: An outside agent changes priorities or imposes new demands.

name: Rule Mutation
description: Core rules of the activity change during execution.

name: Information Shift
description: Previously hidden or known information changes distribution.
